extracted.intended_audience: authors and creators seeking sensitivity reading or cultural consultation (fiction, non-fiction, games, marketing, academic writing)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service standards for sensitivity reading and cultural consultation to ensure authentic, inclusive representation across manuscripts, outlines, games, and other creative materials. Distinguishes service levels, deliverables, and reviewer expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural accuracy and authentic representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity readers meticulously review your manuscript, ensuring cultural accuracy and authentic representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clients should expect respectful, inclusive, and informed content that resonates; sensitivity readers use lived experience and knowledge to correct inaccuracies and improve authenticity. The page emphasizes representation as essential and links to resources showing industry diversity shortfalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification and mitigation of microaggressions, problematic word choice, and outdated tropes
rubrics_metrics.description: Readers scrutinize your work for microaggressions, word choice accuracy, and outdated tropes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services provide nuanced critique to enrich writing and promote true representation rather than reinforcing harmful stereotypes. Anti-patterns include casual repetition of stereotypes or imprecise/slur-like language; reviewers will flag and suggest alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of expert/targeted readers with lived experience or domain knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert readers (called 'targeted beta readers') possess real-life experiences or in-depth knowledge aligned with a narrative's core elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match protagonist/subject matter to reader expertise (e.g., horse enthusiast for equestrian details). Expert readers spot intricate details that add authenticity and depth. The service encourages browsing reader profiles to select appropriate expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service-level scope: Cultural Consultation (question-based, no manuscript review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cultural Consultation is a flat-fee service providing either a one-hour video discussion or three rounds of questions via email; it does not involve manuscript review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this option for quick queries on lived experiences, plotting to avoid a stereotype, or early-stage questions. It's explicitly question-based support at every step but excludes manuscript annotations or editorial letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service-level scope: Sensitivity & Expert Reading (manuscript review, single-character development)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity & Expert Reading includes manuscript review, a standard Salt & Sage Editors letter, inline comments, and character development focused on deepening a single character alongside sensitivity expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This package is appropriate when you want manuscript-level sensitivity feedback and targeted character-level development. It includes inline comments and a standard editors letter; pricing includes a base up to 10,000 words plus per-word overage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service-level scope: Editorial Sensitivity Read (comprehensive editorial + sensitivity feedback)
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial Sensitivity Read provides enhanced editorial feedback: an enhanced Salt & Sage Editors letter, inline comments, comprehensive character development for all characters, and editorial notes on character arcs, world building, pacing, plot development, emotional resonance, and editorial feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a deeper editorial engagement combining sensitivity reading with full developmental editorial guidance. Use when you need both representation accuracy and structural/story-level improvements. Priced higher with a base and per-word overage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliverables: manuscript review, inline comments, and editors letter
rubrics_metrics.description: Services may include manuscript review, inline comments (annotations), and a Salt & Sage Editors letter (standard or enhanced) as deliverables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table clarifies which package includes which deliverables: Cultural Consultation lacks manuscript review and inline comments; Sensitivity & Expert Reading includes standard letter and inline comments; Editorial Sensitivity Read includes enhanced letter and more extensive inline comments and editorial feedback. Expect different levels of commentary depending on package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character development granularity
rubrics_metrics.description: For the Sensitivity & Expert Read, 'Character Development' refers to deepening a single character; the Editorial Sensitivity Read covers comprehensive character development for all characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose Sensitivity & Expert Read for focused development of one character with sensitivity insights; choose Editorial Sensitivity Read for broad character-arc and ensemble development. The editorial package explicitly covers character arcs, world building, and emotional resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and media applicability (expanded use cases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity and editorial services apply across a wide range of formats: outlines, story ideas, blurbs, TTRPG, finished manuscripts, pitches, character sketches, illustrations/sketches, video games, marketing material, and academic writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all packages support every format equally—non-textual works (illustrations, sketches) and video games are billed uniquely and may require custom quotes. The page lists which services cover which use cases to help clients select appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing model and word-count thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Pricing includes a base fee covering projects up to 10,000 words, with a per-word overage for longer projects (e.g., $0.024/word for Sensitivity & Expert Reading, $0.049/word for Editorial Sensitivity Read); Cultural Consultation is a flat $240.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project examples illustrate calculations (e.g., a 53,000-word novel billed as base + 43,000 words x per-word rate). Clients should expect clear base vs overage pricing and can request custom quotes for atypical projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom quotes for specialized projects (video games, non-textual works)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pricing for video game projects and non-textual works is tailored to each project's unique needs and requires contacting the company for a custom quote.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complex interactive media or visual assets need bespoke scoping; clients should reach out to discuss deliverables, reviewer expertise required, and pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expertise breadth and collaborative approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity and expert readers bring diverse backgrounds and profound literary understanding; services are positioned as collaborative, personalized partnerships to explore and deepen narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clients should expect a personalized, collaborative consultation that leverages reviewers' unique insights. The page markets the readers as creative partners who help unlock story potential rather than only policing content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended outcomes: respectful, inclusive narratives that avoid harm
rubrics_metrics.description: The primary goal of sensitivity reading is to empower authors to create respectful, inclusive narratives that resonate and avoid harm to real-world groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion frames what success looks like: representation that paints a broader human experience, reduces stereotyping, and increases authenticity. The page cites industry diversity statistics and pushes for active improvement in representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limitations and what each service does not include
rubrics_metrics.description: Cultural Consultation is strictly question-based and does not involve manuscript review; some packages do not include certain deliverables (e.g., cultural consultation lacks editors letter or inline comments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clients must match needs to package scope—do not expect manuscript annotations from a consultation-only purchase. The pricing/comparison table explicitly notes absent features to prevent scope mismatch.
